Multiple 6+2 pin PCI-Express VGA Card Connector
AURUM 92+ Series is built with the FSP MIA IC technology which advances Active-Clamp Topology to a whole new level.

In addition, it comes with full industrial-grade Japanese capacitors, maximum reliability is undoubtedly ensured. With power efficiency > 92%, AURUM 92+ Series is 80PLUS® platinum certified and yet provides ultimate performance and highest protection that today’s cutting-edge PC components demand.

AURUM 92+ Series is the perfect combination of Technology, Innovation, Eco-friendly and Aesthetics, it comes in 3 wattages, ranging from 450W, 550W to 650W for your choice, AURUM 92+ Series is definitely the best solution for your system.
Arrow-shaped ventilation to provide remarkable air ventilation and superior cooling performance.
Superior electrolyte can tolerate up to 105 °C exetreme condition, also protect other components making prolonged life span possible.
Matching with a quiet and long lasting 120mm fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan, under a comfortable temperature all the time.

This unit could become much better and far more competitive with a couple simple refinements. Nevertheless, it still achieves a good overall performance with its stronger point being the high efficiency it achieves overall.
